children: On November 24, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company that it is not in compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) because it has not filed its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The notice has no immediate effect on the stock's listing; the company has until January 23, 2027, to submit a compliance plan, and Nasdaq may allow until May 24, 2027, to regain compliance if it accepts the plan.
